facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog says an interactive ad can outline 4 distinct features of a single product without any text on the ad, which saves ad space on smaller ad sizes.
facts.quote: With the ad being interactive, you can outline 4 distinct features of a single product, without having text present on the ad

facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog defines an interactive ad as one that invites the user to perform an action, such as hovering or clicking, to reveal something within the ad or navigate to a landing page.
facts.quote: An interactive ad invites the user to perform an action in order to have something revealed within the ad itself, or to navigate towards a specific landing page.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog describes a carousel interactive ad as an ad format that showcases multiple products, where each product can click through to its product page and a CTA button leads to a page showing all items.
facts.quote: This is called a carousel interactive ad, and might look like this:

facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog states that clicks on individual products in a carousel interactive ad can be tracked per product to help identify best sellers.
facts.quote: You can also track these clicks per product to help identify best sellers, and gain insights like if a certain demographic is more interested in a series of products.

facts.fact: The StackAdapt blog post 'The benefits of interactive ads for your digital campaigns' was published on 2019-11-25.
